0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Grizzlies hosting the Utah Jazz at FedExForum. The 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, and the most recent meeting came on April 10, 2026, in Salt Lake City, where the Grizzlies lost 147-101. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (out, ankle), while GG Jackson (ankle) and Jerami Grant (soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot) with Blake Hinson (hamstring), Kyle Filipowski (back), and Trey Alexander (knee) also day-to-day and game-time decisions.
